name: GO Classes CS Test Series 2025 | Algorithms | Topic Wise Test 2

question.text:
Let $T(n)=2 T(n / 2)+O(n),$ where "$O$" is big-oh. What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$

  1. $\Theta(n)$
  2. $\Theta(n \log n)$
  3. $\Theta\left(n^ 2\right)$
  4. $O\left(n^ 3\right)$

Let 
$$
T(n)=\sqrt{n} \cdot T(\sqrt{n})+n
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n) ?$

  1. $\Theta(\sqrt{n} \log n)$
  2. $\Theta(\log \log n)$
  3. $\Theta(n \log \log n)$
  4. $\Theta(\sqrt{n} \log \log n)$

Let $T(n)=T(a n)+T(b n)+n,$ where $a+b<1$.

What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$

  1. $\Theta(n)$
  2. $\Theta\left(n^ 2\right)$
  3. $\Theta(n \log n)$
  4. $\Theta((a+b) \log n)$

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)= \begin{cases}2 T(n / 2)+8 T(n / 4)+n^{2} & \text { if } n \geq 4 \\
1 & \text { if } n \leq 3\end{cases}
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$ 

  1. $\Theta\left(n^ 2 \log n\right)$
  2. $\Theta\left(n^ 2\right)$
  3. $\Theta\left(n^ 3\right)$
  4. $\Theta\left(n^ 3 \log n \right)$

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)=2 T(\sqrt{n})+\log n
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n) ?$

  1. $\Theta(\log n)$
  2. $\Theta(\log \log n)$
  3. $\Theta(\log n \log \log n)$
  4. $\Theta(n \log n)$

Consider mutually recursive definitions of $T(a, b)$ and $S(c, d)$ :
$$
\begin{array}{rlr}
T(x, c) & =\Theta(x) & \text { for } c \leq 2 \\
T(x, y) & =\Theta(x)+S(x, y / 2), &\\
S(c, y) & =\Theta(y) & \text { for } c \leq 2, \text { and }\\
S(x, y) & =\Theta(y)+T(x / 2, y) &
\end{array}
$$
Select the correct asymptotic complexity of an algorithm with run-time $T(n, n)$.

  1. $\Theta(\log n)$.
  2. $\Theta(n)$.
  3. $\Theta(n \log n)$.
  4. $\Theta\left(n \log ^{2} n\right)$.

Let $S(n)$ be
$$
S(n)=S(n / 2)+\log (n) .
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $S(n)$?

  1. $\Theta(n \log n)$
  2. $\Theta(\log n)$
  3. $\Theta(\log \log n)$
  4. $\Theta\left((\log n)^ 2\right)$

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)=n^{2}+T(n / 2)+T(n / 4)
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$ 

  1. $\Theta\left(n^ 2\right)$
  2. $\Theta\left(n^ 3\right)$
  3. $\Theta\left(n^ 4\right)$
  4. $\Theta\left(n^ 2 \log n\right)$

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)=64 T(n / 4)+8^{\log _{2} n}
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$ 

  1. $\Theta\left(n^ 3(\log n)^ 3\right)$
  2. $\Theta\left(n^ 3\right)$
  3. $\Theta\left(n^ 3 \log n\right)$
  4. $\Theta\left(n^ 4\right)$

Consider a recurrence relation.
$$
T(n)=\alpha T(n / 2)+n^{2} .
$$
Let $a \geq 1$ be an integer.

Which of the following is/are true?

  1. For $\alpha>4, T(n)=\theta\left(n^{\lg \alpha}\right)$
  2. For $\alpha=4, T(n)=\theta\left(n^{2} \lg n\right)$
  3. For $\alpha<4, T(n)=\theta\left(n^{2}\right)$
  4. For all values of $\alpha, T(n)=\theta\left(n^{2} \lg n\right)$

A list of $n$ arrays, each of length $n,$ is passed to an algorithm like merge-sort. The algorithm recursively divides a set of arrays into two parts until there are only two arrays.

If there are two arrays, then, as a base case, the algorithm combines or merges both in cost of $\mathrm{O}(p+q)$ where $p$ and $q$ are sizes of arrays.

What will be the time complexity recurrence relation of such algorithm?

Let $T(n)$ be time taken for $n$ arrays.

  1. $T(n)=2 T(n / 2)+n^ 2$
  2. $T(n)=2 T(n / 2)+n$
  3. $T(n)=2 T(n / 2)+n^ 3$
  4. None of these

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)=16 T(n / 4)+n^{2}(\log n)^{3}
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$

  1. $\Theta\left(n^ 2(\log n)^ 3\right)$
  2. $\Theta\left(n^ 2(\log n)^ 4\right)$
  3. $\Theta\left(n^ 3 \log n\right)$
  4. $\Theta\left(n^ 3(\log n)^ 3\right)$

Select the correct asymptotic complexity of an algorithm with runtime $T(n, n)$ where

  • $T(x, c)=\Theta(x) \quad$ for $c \leq 2$,
  • $T(c, y)=\Theta(y) \quad$ for $c \leq 2$, and
  • $T(x, y)=\Theta(x)+T(x, y / 2) $
  1. $\Theta(\log n)$
  2. $\Theta(n)$
  3. $\Theta(n \log n)$
  4. $\Theta\left(n \log ^{2} n\right)$

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)=T(\sqrt{n})+\log \log n
$$
What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n)?$

  1. $\Theta(\log n)$
  2. $\Theta((\log \log n)^2)$
  3. $\Theta(\log \log \log n)$
  4. $\Theta(\log \log \log \log n)$

Let $T(n)$ be
$$
T(n)=2 T\left(\frac{n}{2}\right)+\frac{n}{\lg n}
$$

$T(2) =1$

What will be asymptotic bound on $T(n) ?$

  1. $\Theta\left(n^ 2(\log n)\right)$
  2. $\Theta\left(n(\log n)^ 2\right)$
  3. $\Theta(n \log \log n)$
  4. $\Theta\left(n^ 2 \log \log n\right)$
